question_text: A car travels from City A to B at 60 km/h and returns at 40 km/h. Average speed for round trip?

hint_ladder.title: Average Speed Formula
hint_ladder.text: Average speed = total distance / total time. Hindi pwedeng i-average lang ang speeds dahil magkaiba ang oras.

hint_ladder.title: Assume distance
hint_ladder.text: Pumili ng convenient distance, like LCM ng 60 at 40: 120 km. Parang isang biyahe mula Manila to Baguio?

hint_ladder.title: Times
hint_ladder.text: Going: 120/60 = 2 hrs. Return: 120/40 = 3 hrs. Total distance = 240 km, total time = 5 hrs.

hint_ladder.title: Compute
hint_ladder.text: Average speed = 240 km / 5 h = 48 km/h. Option A ang sagot!

A.text: Correct. Total distance ÷ total time = 48 km/h. Tamang sagot gamit ang harmonic mean.

B.text: You might have chosen B because you simply averaged 60 and 40, forgetting that the travel times are different.

C.text: You might have chosen C because of a calculation error, perhaps adding 2 to the simple average of 50.

D.text: You might have chosen D because you miscalculated by adding 5 to the simple average of 50.

next_time_rule: **Key Takeaway:** Average speed = total distance ÷ total time. Iwasan ang simpleng pag-average ng speeds kung magkaiba ang oras!
deconstruct_text:
Halimbawa, nag-drive ka mula sa inyong LGU office sa Vigan papuntang seminar sa Laoag. Papunta, mabilis sa highway, 60 km/h. Pauwi, traffic sa bayan kaya 40 km/h lang. Alamin ang average speed.

Gamitin ang formula: Average speed = total distance ÷ total time. Hindi simple average ng speeds dahil magkaiba ang oras na ginugol sa bawat speed.

Pumili ng convenient distance, gamit ang Least Common Multiple ng 60 at 40: 120 km one way. Kaya total distance = 240 km.

Oras papunta: 120 km / 60 km/h = 2 oras. Oras pauwi: 120 km / 40 km/h = 3 oras. Total time = 5 oras.

Average speed = 240 km / 5 h = 48 km/h.

**Watch-Out Zone: ratio_total_part_confusion** in action. Hindi puwede simpleng average.
